name: Why is garage insulation especially important in the Denver area?

mainEntity.name: Why is garage insulation especially important in the Denver area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Denver metro and Front Range climate, winters bring sub-freezing days while summers deliver intense dry heat. Proper insulation buffers your home against these sharp swings, preventing plumbing lines routed through garage walls from freezing and lowering summer heat gain through shared walls. Because Aurora and Denver experience rapid weather shifts, pairing batt insulation with proper air sealing around framed edges prevents cold drafts from bypassing the thermal layer altogether.
acceptedAnswer.description: Denver's freezing winters and hot summers make garage insulation vital for protecting pipes, moderating home temperatures, and stopping seasonal drafts.
